subject.title: feat: add codexbar guard — quota-aware exit code to gate automation

question: Should CodexBar establish `codexbar guard` as a supported automation API, and what provider/window vocabulary should its first stable contract guarantee?
rationale: This adds a new public command, flags, JSON schema, and exit-code contract whose compatibility and provider semantics cannot safely be chosen from implementation details alone.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed MVP
options.body: Approve the feature after replacing universal session/weekly aliases with provider-correct semantics and proving reachable safe and blocked outcomes.

options.title: Approve the proposed contract
options.body: Accept session/weekly aliases and the current exit-code schema as the intended generic interface despite provider-window variation.

options.title: Keep quota decisions external
options.body: Decline a stable guard command and retain `codexbar usage --json` as the composable data interface for caller-owned policy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrowed MVP
recommendation.body: Approve the feature after replacing universal session/weekly aliases with provider-correct semantics and proving reachable safe and blocked outcomes.
